about.title: About LATECE — Assistive Technology Laboratory UFRN
about.heroSubtitle: Our mission, vision, and the objectives that drive us to create a more accessible future.
about.whoWeAreText1: The Assistive Technology Laboratory of the Education Center (LATECE), linked to the Interdisciplinary Laboratory of Educator Training (LIFE) at the Federal University of Rio Grande do Norte, is a space for teaching, research, and community outreach dedicated to Assistive Technology.
about.whoWeAreText2: Assistive Technology comprises resources, strategies, services, and practices aimed at promoting accessibility, autonomy, and participation for people with disabilities and specific educational needs. The laboratory operates in different areas of Assistive Technology, such as Alternative Communication, computer accessibility, postural adjustment, mobility, sensory accessibility, and the production of accessible pedagogical materials.
about.whoWeAreText3: Founded in 2017, LATECE conducts research, training activities, and projects focused on accessibility and inclusion. The laboratory maintains partnerships with schools, specialized services, university sectors, and higher education institutions. Part of the laboratory's actions and resources is made possible through research and innovation grants funded by the National Council for Scientific and Technological Development (CNPq) and the Brazilian Innovation Agency (FINEP).
about.missionText: To develop and disseminate innovative assistive technologies that promote inclusion, autonomy, and quality of life for people with disabilities, fostering a collaborative learning and research environment.
about.visionText: To be a national and international reference center in research, development, and innovation in Assistive Technology, transforming society through inclusive technology.
about.teachingText: Integration of teaching, research, and extension actions focused on inclusion and accessibility.
about.trainingText: Initial and continuing education of teachers to work in inclusive contexts.
about.assistiveText: Development and adaptation of Assistive Technology resources for different needs.
about.materialsText: Production of accessible pedagogical materials to support inclusive educational processes.
about.communicationText: Research and practices focused on Augmentative and Alternative Communication.
about.partnershipsText: Collaboration with schools, specialized services, and university sectors.
about.justificationText1: Assistive technology is a vital field for ensuring the rights and full participation of people with disabilities in society. In Brazil, the demand for accessible and innovative solutions is growing, driven by legislation and social awareness.
about.justificationText2: LATECE emerges as a strategic response to this demand, positioning UFRN at the forefront of inclusion research. Our laboratory not only creates technology but also trains the next generation of experts in the field.
about.justificationText3: By integrating research, teaching, and community outreach, LATECE creates a virtuous cycle that benefits students, researchers, and, most importantly, the community, generating a lasting and significant social impact.
about.highlightText: We focus on open-source and open-hardware projects to maximize the reach and replicability of our solutions, ensuring that technology reaches those who need it most.
about.ctaText: Your passion for technology and inclusion can make a difference. Get to know our team and our projects.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.text: By accessing and using the Assistive Technology Laboratory of the Education Center (LATECE) Portal, linked to the Federal University of Rio Grande do Norte (UFRN), you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any provision described herein, we ask that you do not use the Portal.

section2.title: 2. Description of Service
section2.text: The LATECE Portal is an institutional website of an informative and academic nature, whose purpose is:
list: To disseminate information about the Assistive Technology Laboratory
To present research, extension, and teaching projects developed by LATECE
To provide information about the team, equipment, and publications
To publish news and events related to assistive technology and inclusive education
To promote the visibility of the laboratory's actions to the academic community and society
section2.note: The Portal does not carry out commercial transactions, does not offer paid services, and does not require registration of common users for browsing.

section4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
section4.text: The user agrees to use the Portal ethically and in accordance with current legislation, and it is forbidden:

section5.title: 5. Data Collection
section5.text: The LATECE Portal does not collect personally identifiable information from common visitors. However, technical data is automatically collected for security and service improvement purposes. For detailed information about the data collected and its processing, please see our Privacy Policy.

section2.title: 2. Automatically Collected Data
section2.text: The LATECE Portal is an institutional website of a public and informational nature. We do not require registration, login, or any form of personal identification for visitors. However, during browsing, certain technical data is automatically collected by the servers and infrastructure of the site. Additionally, certain data are not requested or collected automatically, but may be voluntarily provided by the user.

section2.logsText: When technical errors occur on the Portal, the server automatically records logs containing information such as: the URL accessed, the type of error, the IP address of the requester, and the timestamp of the event. These logs are used exclusively for technical diagnosis and fault correction, and are retained for a maximum of 90 days.
section2.cookieText: The Portal uses a single essential technical cookie:
cookieRows: Maintain the session of authenticated administrators in the administrative panel
section2.cookieNote: This cookie is created only when an administrator logs into the administrative panel. Regular visitors to the Portal do not receive this cookie. The Portal does not use tracking, marketing, or advertising cookies.

section3.title: 3. Voluntarily Provided Data (Forms and Registrations)
section3.text: On specific occasions (such as contact forms, event registrations, workshops, or participation in research), the user may voluntarily provide personal data. In these cases, the following guidelines apply:
list: What data is requested: Only those strictly necessary for the specific purpose (e.g., name and email for contact or certification).
What they are used for: Exclusively for the purpose informed at the time of collection (e.g., to respond to the message, issue a certificate).

Who receives and third parties involved: Data is received only by the LATECE team responsible for the demand. There is no sharing with third parties, except for institutional UFRN platforms for issuing certificates or academic systems, if applicable.

Storage and retention: Data may be forwarded by institutional email or temporarily stored in the database. They are retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose, and then deleted, subject to UFRN's legal obligations.
How to request deletion: The data subject may, at any time, request the deletion of their voluntary data by sending an email to latece@ufrn.br, subject to technical and legal feasibility analysis.

section4.title: 4. Data NOT Collected
section4.text: For full transparency, we declare that the LATECE Portal does NOT collect the following types of data:
list: Name, ID, or other identification documents from visitors (except voluntary form filling)
Email or phone number from visitors (except voluntary form filling)
Payment data or financial information
Biometric data (fingerprint, facial recognition)
Health data
Precise geolocation (GPS)
Behavioral data for advertising or profiling purposes

section5.title: 5. Purpose of Data Processing
section5.text: Automatically collected technical data is used exclusively for:
list: Ensuring the security and stability of the Portal
Preventing and detecting malicious activities (DDoS attacks, intrusion attempts, spam)
Generating aggregated and anonymous statistics on Portal usage
Diagnosing and correcting technical failures
Complying with legal obligations under the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet (Law No. 12.965/2014)

section6.title: 6. Data Sharing
section6.text: Data collected by the LATECE Portal is not shared with third parties for commercial purposes. Sharing may occur only in the following hypotheses:
list: With the Superintendence of Information Technology (STI) of UFRN, responsible for the network infrastructure and servers
With public authorities, upon court order or legal determination, as provided by law
To comply with legal or regulatory obligations

section7.title: 7. Data Subject Rights
section7.text: In accordance with Art. 18 of the General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: Confirmation — Confirm the existence of processing of personal data
Access — Access the personal data we process about you
Correction — Request the correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
Anonymization, blocking, or deletion — Request the anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary or non-compliant data
Portability — Request the portability of data to another service provider, subject to the requirements and limitations set forth in the LGPD and applicable regulations for Public Administration
Deletion — Request the deletion of personal data processed with consent
Information — Be informed about entities with which your data has been shared
Revocation — Revoke consent at any time (applicable to cases where processing is based solely on consent, such as voluntary forms)
section7.contact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at latece@ufrn.br.

section8.title: 8. Data Security
section8.text: The LATECE Portal adopts technical and administrative measures to protect processed data, including:
list: Communication encryption via HTTPS/TLS
HTTP security headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, HSTS)
Protection against XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) and CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) attacks
Rate limiting to prevent abuse and brute force attacks
JWT token authentication with automatic expiration
Administrator passwords stored with bcrypt hash (never in plain text)
Validation and sanitization of all data inputs
Parameterized database queries (prevention of SQL Injection)

section9.title: 9. Data Retention
section9.text: Collected data is retained for the following periods:

section10.title: 10. International Transfer and Third-Party Services
section10.text: Some Portal pages may incorporate third-party services, such as videos hosted on YouTube. When accessing embedded content, certain technical information (such as IP address and technical cookies) may be processed by the respective provider, in accordance with their own privacy policies.
section10.note: In these cases, data transfer and processing occur under the responsibility of these third parties, in compliance with the data protection laws applicable to their services.

section11.title: 11. Protection of Minors
section11.text: The institutional Portal does not request or deliberately collect personal data from children and adolescents for browsing or advertising purposes.
section11.note: Any processing of personal data of children and adolescents carried out within the scope of LATECE research, projects, or academic activities will observe its own legal, ethical, and institutional requirements, including, when applicable, the rules regarding research involving human subjects.

section12.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
section12.text: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in data processing practices or applicable legislation. The date of the last update is always indicated at the top of this document. We recommend that you check this page regularly.
